sentences.text: Macbeth -LRB- or The Tragedy of Macbeth -RRB- is a 1971 British-American historical drama film directed by Roman Polanski and co-written by Polanski and Kenneth Tynan .	Roman Polanski	Roman Polanski	Kenneth Tynan	Kenneth Tynan	The Tragedy of Macbeth	Macbeth	historical	Historical period drama	drama film	Drama (film and television)

A film adaptation of William Shakespeare 's tragedy of the same name , it retells the story of the Highland lord who becomes King of Scotland through treachery and murder .	William Shakespeare	William Shakespeare	film adaptation	film adaptation	same name	Macbeth	Highland	Scottish Highlands

The film stars Jon Finch as the title character and Francesca Annis as Lady Macbeth , noted for their relative youth as actors .	Jon Finch	Jon Finch	Francesca Annis	Francesca Annis	title character	Macbeth (character)	Lady Macbeth	Lady Macbeth

Themes of historic recurrence , greater pessimism and internal ugliness in physically beautiful characters are added to Shakespeare 's story of moral decline , which is presented in a more realistic style .	historic recurrence	historic recurrence

The production , funded by Playboy Enterprises , was troubled by poor weather around the British Isles , and the film was a box office bomb .	Playboy Enterprises	Playboy Enterprises	British Isles	British Isles	box office bomb	box office bomb
Polanski 's Macbeth was screened out of competition at the 1972 Cannes Film Festival .	1972 Cannes Film Festival	1972 Cannes Film Festival

It was somewhat controversial for its depictions of graphic violence and nudity , but has also received positive attention , and was named Best Film by the National Board of Review .	Best Film	National Board of Review Award for Best Film	National Board of Review	National Board of Review
